title: One-variable stats on an online TI-84

steps.note: Everything to do with lists and one-variable summaries starts here, not in the main calculation screen.

steps.intent: choose 1: Edit to open the list editor
steps.note: Edit is the list editor. CALC, one tab over, is where the summary stats live once the data is entered.

steps.intent: type the values into L1, one per row
steps.note: Press Enter after each value. If L1 already has data in it, clear the column first or the stats will be wrong.

steps.intent: run 1-Var Stats on L1 from the CALC tab
steps.note: The first line of the output is the mean. Scroll down for the median and the quartiles.
